tokens.name: orchid
tokens.usage: Primitive from the reference palette. Decorative fills; the accent in dark. Fails 3:1 on white, so light-theme charts use `accent`.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Primitive from the reference palette. Decorative fills; chart-3 in dark. Fails 3:1 on white.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind cards and the sidebar.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sidebar, table, inputs, popovers, modals.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header, segmented-tab track, neutral badge, disabled inputs.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on rows, menu items, ghost and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders, row dividers, progress track.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, checkbox, switch track off). 3:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text. On bg, surface, surface-sunken, surface-hover, primary-soft and every *-soft ground in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels in tables, alert body. On bg, surface, surface-sunken and the *-soft grounds (≥4.5:1 both themes).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, section labels, optional markers. On surface and surface-sunken (≥4.5:1 both themes).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary action, active nav, selected tab, focus border, chart-1. As text on surface, bg and primary-soft.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on primary buttons.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Selected nav item, selected table row, stat-card icon chip, focus halo.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill. Never hard-code white: dark theme uses deep violet.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Orchid accent: chart-2, decorative highlights. 4.1:1 on white, 6.6:1 on dark surface.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind accent-ink (badge, avatar tint).

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Orchid as text, on accent-soft and surface.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Ativo, aprovado, folha fechada. As text on surface and success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background for success badges and alerts.

tokens.name: warning

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background for warning badges and alerts.

tokens.name: danger

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background for danger badges, alerts, the destructive modal icon.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill.

tokens.name: info

tokens.usage: Background for info badges and alerts.
